correctness.rationale: The map is f(n)=product over base-3 digits of (d+2) for n>0. A separate independent exact-int enumerator followed all 4095 initial integers 1<=n<4096 until repetition, filtering a start only when on its eventual cycle. Exactly {36,64,72,144,288,1152} are periodic; 64<->72 and 4096->10368->4608->4096 checked by separate digit expansions. Maximum intermediate value 41472, maximum eight distinct orbit values before repeat. Hence least nonfixed periodic start 64 and least period>=3 start 4096. Bounded theorem only, not a global dynamics statement.
residual_risks: Informal or unindexed tabulations may already list these cycle minima.
